dct_description_sm:
Brampton Plan Watercourses include rivers, streams, creeks, and drainage channels that form part of Brampton's natural and hydrological systems. These features convey water across the landscape, provide important ecological functions, and contribute to flood management, environmental health, and natural heritage connectivity.  For more up-to-date data, refer to other open data sources on GeoHub.


This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
